final: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg), baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS baseline_shortintrt FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist), per_transaction AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM matched GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist) SELECT p.transreg, p.ordertypedist, p.avg_shortintrt, p.avg_optvolrt, p.avg_shortintrt / b.baseline_shortintrt AS shortintrt_ratio FROM per_transaction AS p LEFT JOIN baselines AS b ON b.ordertypedist IS p.ordertypedist ORDER BY shortintrt_ratio IS NULL, shortintrt_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
